description: This file implements the AVDTP (Audio/Video Distribution Transport Protocol) profile for Bluetooth, including client and server methods for discovering endpoints, getting capabilities, setting configurations, and managing endpoint states.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Implements Bluetooth AVDTP client functionalities such as discovering endpoints, configuring, and retrieving configurations.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: Implements Bluetooth AVDTP server functionalities including endpoint discovery, capability retrieval, configuration, and state management.

methods.name: Client::Discover
methods.description: Discovers available stream endpoints and retrieves their capabilities.

methods.name: Client::SetConfiguration
methods.description: Sets configuration for a specific stream endpoint.

methods.name: Client::GetConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves configuration data for a specific remote endpoint.

methods.name: Server::OnDiscover
methods.description: Handles discovery requests, listing all available endpoints.

methods.name: Server::OnGetCapabilities
methods.description: Handles requests to retrieve basic capabilities of a specific endpoint.

methods.name: Server::OnGetAllCapabilities
methods.description: Handles requests to retrieve all capabilities of a specific endpoint.

methods.name: Server::OnSetConfiguration
methods.description: Handles configuration setting requests for an endpoint.

methods.name: Server::OnReconfigure
methods.description: Handles partial reconfiguration requests for an endpoint.

methods.name: Server::OnOpen
methods.description: Handles requests to change endpoint state from CONFIGURED to OPENED.

methods.name: Server::OnClose
methods.description: Handles requests to change endpoint state from OPENED to CONFIGURED.

methods.name: Server::OnStart
methods.description: Handles requests to change endpoint state from OPENED to STARTED.

methods.name: Server::OnSuspend
methods.description: Handles requests to change endpoint state from STARTED to OPENED.

methods.name: Server::OnAbort
methods.description: Handles requests to change endpoint state to IDLE.
